items.text: The page has no h1 element. The outline starts at h2 ('Learn about knees...'), and the logo text 'Knee Guru' is not a heading.
items.evidence: facts h1_count: 0, h1: null; heading_outline[0] is level 2 'Learn about knees...'

items.text: The heading hierarchy skips from h2 to h4 for the Learning Portfolio category labels. h3 is used later for article titles.
items.evidence: heading_outline: h2 'Learning Portfolio' followed by h4 'PRIMERS', 'COURSES', etc.; h3 used under 'Latest Content'

items.text: Two font families split the type. Helvetica Neue is used for headings, nav and link-style labels, and Georgia serif for body and description text.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: Georgia 124, Helvetica Neue 114; slice 1 card descriptions are in serif and titles in sans

items.text: Section h2s are 35.2px, weight 700, in dark blue. Each sits on a short blue underline bar that matches the heading's text width.

items.text: Body text is 16px with a 25.6px line height (a 1.6 ratio). The text color is a dark slate, not pure black.

items.text: The palette is mostly blue. The main text and accent colors are a mid blue rgb(29,111,165) and a darker navy rgb(20,80,122).

features.statement: Page has no h1; heading outline begins at h2 and the logo text is not a heading.
Heading levels are skipped, such as h2 followed directly by h4 category labels.
Pairs a sans-serif for headings, navigation and labels with a serif for body and description text.
Section h2s are large bold dark blue, each sitting on a short blue underline bar matching text width.
Body text is 16px with a 1.6 line height in dark slate rather than pure black.
Palette is dominated by mid blue and dark navy for text, accents and backgrounds.
Small uppercase letter-spaced labels are used for taglines and category titles.
Buttons and inputs have small 4px radii; corners are mostly square and nothing is pill-shaped.
Social links are plain text labels without icons.
Main navigation is a single row of plain text links aligned right beside the logo, with no dropdown indicators or active highlight.
Thin grey borders separate header from content, and cards use thin light-grey borders.
Hero is two columns: heading and link list on the left, a large square photo on the right.
Hero photo has rounded corners and a soft drop shadow.
Link lists use short lowercase verb-led task phrases, with small arrow image bullets and dashed dividers.
Headings use trailing ellipsis for a conversational, inviting tone.
Cards have centred content: an icon, uppercase blue sans title and serif description.
Icons are multicolored flat illustrations in varied colors rather than one uniform set.
Section backgrounds alternate between white and pale blue tint.
Content cards have a thick blue left border accent on a white background.
Summaries contain inline underlined links to glossary-style terms.
Cards in a row stretch to equal height regardless of text length.
Cards show only title and summary, with no thumbnails, dates or bylines.
Sponsor/logo row mixes images and text-only links, with inconsistent framing of logos.
Italic text is used for secondary links and disclaimers.
Footer is a dark near-black navy band with white headings, grey text and light-blue underlined links.
Footer headings are much smaller than body-section h2s and lack the underline bar.
Email signup pairs a white text input with a solid blue button.
Content sits in a centred fixed-width container within a wide viewport.
Copy is plain, factual and informational, with no emoji, exclamation marks, CTA banners or marketing hero.
Page uses sparse non-utility class names, with styles in a single embedded style block.
Page is link-heavy, with many anchors and list items and few buttons.
Uses landmark elements header, nav, main, sections and footer, without aside or figure.
All images have alt attributes, descriptive for content images and empty for decorative ones.
Page title uses an en dash separator and repeats the tagline.
Footer includes formal legal and administrative text such as company numbers and postal address.
Accessibility aids such as text-size controls and a certification seal are included.
